preconditions.description: The number of files n and the number of files to be deleted m are within the range [1, 100].

preconditions.expression: All filenames are non-empty strings containing only lowercase English letters, digits, and dots ('.').
preconditions.description: The filenames consist of allowed characters only.

preconditions.expression: The length of each filename doesn't exceed 100.
preconditions.description: The length of filenames is within the range [1, 100].

preconditions.expression: The indices of files to be deleted are distinct and in ascending order.
preconditions.description: The indices of files to be deleted are given in a valid order without repetition.

postconditions.expression: If a pattern exists, print 'Yes' followed by the pattern in the next line.
postconditions.description: The output should indicate the existence of a pattern and provide the pattern itself.
The output should indicate the absence of a pattern.
